intro: Call of Earth is a sacred trial of communion where an initiate obtains a piece of Rough Quartz from an earth spirit. Brought to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove, this mineral shard becomes the core of the practitioner's first Earth Totem, grounding their bond with the elemental forces.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.
Be patient, friend. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among adventurer--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.
The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.
But for now, take this earth totem...
